d:
Watch 'Yaarumilla' from Kaaviyathalaivan, a tranquil number that takes the listener back in time. With Shweta Mohan & Srinivas rendering this song to beautiful perfection, the track is magical.
Video Name - Yaarumilla
Movie - Kaaviyathalaivan
Singer - Shweta Mohan & Srinivas
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Pa. Vijay
Director - Vasanthabalan
Starring - Siddharth, Vedhika
